description: Approve or deny actions waiting for a decision. With run_id: a run in needs_input; decide every one of its pending_approval_ids at once and it resumes in the background. Without run_id: approvals a script run or the API raised; each approved one runs its frozen call now and the reply carries its outcome. An approval nobody answers is denied after 7 days.

approvals.description: One decision per approval id. A run stays paused until every one of its pending ids is answered.

approved.description: True to let the action run, false to deny it.

run_id.description: The paused run (trun_...). Omit it for approvals a script run or the API raised.

name: resolve_approvals

anyOf.description: A task run — one delegated job and what is known about its state.

items.description: A file the work produced. Exchange its id for a download link with get_file_download_url.

cancel_requested_at.description: Set once a stop was requested; the run stays running until it reaches its next step, then settles as cancelled.

json.description: The reply parsed as JSON and validated against response_format. Present only when one was given.

json_error.description: Why the reply did not parse or validate against response_format.

wait_timed_out.description: The wait ended first. The work is still running: follow it with the tool next_step names.

anyOf.description: The approvals answered, as each stands now.

items.description: A gated action, frozen as it was called, and where it stands. Approving runs it once: then `result` or `error` holds the outcome.

reason.description: Why it was denied, or that it expired.
